column1: # Authored from the 2024 PHB SRD (CC-BY 4.0). Spot-check against the printed PHB — wording may have been adjusted in errata.

column2: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.
column4: Adds advantage on saves vs the Frightened condition

column2: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but you can't stop in the same space.
column4: Adds 'move through larger creatures' movement option

column2: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.
column4: Adds Halfling Luck reroll on natural 1s on D20 Tests

column2: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.
You can speak, read, and write Common and Halfling.
column4: Auto adds Common, Halfling to languages
